payload.name: Changing Live Data: Look, Copy, Check, Apply One, Verify, Keep a Way Back
payload.description: A change to the operator's live store follows one procedure: look first, copy everything it touches, check coverage and references by hand, apply one pilot at a time, verify independently, and keep and label a restore path.

principles.name: Reversible by construction
principles.description: A data change is only as safe as the copy taken before it and the check made after it.

principles.name: The script is not the verifier
principles.description: A script that reports success is a claim; the check is made separately.

heuristics.condition: a script offers to apply and delete in one run
heuristics.action: make it dry-run by default and fail closed on any unmet condition

heuristics.condition: a restore path has never been run
heuristics.action: say so plainly next to the recipe

decision_rules.name: Look before touching
decision_rules.condition: live data on the EU is about to change
decision_rules.outcome: inspect first: service health, the expected ids present, no partial earlier run, binary unchanged; stop if anything differs

decision_rules.name: Copy before change
decision_rules.condition: any container, body or history is to be written or deleted
decision_rules.outcome: save before-copies of every affected container, body and version history, and of the canonical they point at; refuse to write without them

decision_rules.name: Read coverage by hand
decision_rules.condition: a duplicate is merged or removed
decision_rules.outcome: read rule by rule that the canonical holds every rule and heuristic of the duplicate, verbatim or restated

decision_rules.name: Scan every reference
decision_rules.condition: an item is about to be deleted
decision_rules.outcome: search the repository, the data directory and every container's local state for its id; repoint each citer first; logs that name the old id stay as history

decision_rules.name: Canonical first, one at a time
decision_rules.outcome: make the canonical content live first, run one pilot, check health between changes, and stop at the first failure with a rollback list

decision_rules.name: Verify independently
decision_rules.outcome: re-read and re-scan yourself: health, container load, reference grep, error journal; the script's own output is not the verification

decision_rules.name: Write the restore and label it
decision_rules.outcome: keep a restore recipe or script with the before-copies, and say that it was not exercised if it was not

decision_rules.name: Destructive means approved
decision_rules.condition: a hard delete or other irreversible change is planned
decision_rules.outcome: run it only on the operator's explicit approval naming the items; changes the operator has delegated, such as merging duplicates and repointing citers, still follow every step above
